meaning: Implementation capability inventory, not proof of device acceptance or complete Legado compatibility

macosExample: Release build and UI; local code signing only
verifiedSnapshot.androidRelease: local unsigned APK and AAR; minifyAppReleaseWithR8 completed; packaged V8 size and SHA-256 match manifest
verifiedSnapshot.acceptanceRound: extraction compatibility and Android chapter acceptance
verifiedSnapshot.debugFlutterAssetConsistency: 10 Flutter assets in AAR and APK have matching SHA-256
verifiedSnapshot.releaseFlutterAssetConsistency: 7 Flutter assets in AAR and APK have matching SHA-256

runtime.historicalEvidence: Older versions and earlier acceptance rounds do not establish the latest implementation snapshot

engine.cookiePersistence: Core export/import; Android source_host persists via PlatformSessionStore
engine.webViewCookieSynchronization: browser.open result imported into HTTP jar; no continuous bidirectional synchronization
engine.paginationContract: Explicit nextPage rule; maxPages default20, allowed1..1000; cycle/limit errors

browserCookieImport.cookieHeader: host-only, response directory path, HTTPS secure; original attributes unavailable

engine.redirects: POST301/302 or303 rewrite GET and remove framing/request-body headers case-insensitively;307/308 preserve body/headers
engine.html4Utility: encoding.unescapeHtml4 via SourceUtilityHost;252 HTML4 entities, single pass,not HTML5

unsupportedApis: legacy comma URL options in Java host HTTP calls
legacy.responseFacadeDifference: body/url callable primitive facade is not strict-equality-equivalent to string properties
legacy.domFacade: read-only subset; no JVM identity or arbitrary methods; html() explicitly unsupported

convertedFields: static headers overlaid on source headers
literalRequestOptions.methodMapping: POST/HEAD retained; other string maps GET

legacy.importLiteralExtractionScripts: getString/getStringList with one literal rule only; nested scripts, compound rules, templates, variables, extra arguments and element APIs require review
legacy.extractionText: getString default HTML4 unescape with boolean override;getStringList no unescape;scalar URL empty text falls back base

migration.ajaxAutomaticConversion: literal URL string only; direct arrays/Array constructors require review; other nonliteral arguments are ambiguous
migration.hostNamespaceConflict: bare source identifier requires review; member properties, comments and strings excluded
migration.literalGetString: parse result wrapped in awaited encoding.unescapeHtml4 except empty rule

androidBridge.closePending: pending responses and ready waits fail with IllegalStateException; no added channel error code
androidBridge.chapterFields: legacyOriginal provenance preserves legacy string truthiness independently of runtime mode;modern Boolean or strict true/false strings;legacy updateTime maps tag;blank volume URL synthesized title+index
